1.consolidated_definition: med. Preservativo. Funda fina y elástica que se coloca en el pene durante la copulación. Anglicismo adaptado, frecuente. El condón, preservativo o profiláctico masculino no es un método de prevención moderno. Hay registros de que en el antiguo Egipto, Grecia y Roma se usaban dispositivos para evitar el embarazo, hechos de diversos materiales como vísceras de cerdo o cordero (Juventud Boricua.com, 06-05-07)
1.en_consolidated_definition: Medical term: Condom. A thin and elastic sheath that is placed on the penis during copulation. This anglicism, adapted from English, is frequently used. The male condom or prophylactic is not a modern method of prevention. There are records indicating that in ancient Egypt, Greece, and Rome, devices were used to prevent pregnancy, made from various materials such as pig or sheep viscera (Juventud Boricua.com, 06-05-07).
